abstract: Twenty-nine ovarian cancer patients with yolk sac tumors and germ cell tumors with yolk sac tissue as a component of their disease (16 endodermal sinus tumor, 11 mixed germ cell tumors, one embryonal carcinoma, and one polyembryoma) were treated with cytoreductive surgery and combination chemotherapy. Prognostic factors were investigated in this group. Patients with Stage I disease had a more favorable prognosis (P less than 0.003) than those with Stages II and IV disease. The difference in prognosis was significant in cases where residual tumor was absent (P less than 0.003) and in cases where ascites was either absent or less than 100 ml in volume (P less than 0.05). Endodermal sinus tumor with either an intestinal (P less than 0.05) or microcystic pattern (P less than 0.01) was more common in survivors than in those who died. The age, preoperative serum alpha-fetoprotein level, maximum tumor size, and tumor weight had no significant correlation with prognosis. In advanced cases, chemotherapy regimens including cisplatin gave better results than those containing vincristine, dactinomycin, and cyclophosphamide (P less than 0.05). The optimal treatment of yolk sac tumors or tumors with yolk sac tissue as a component of the ovary is discussed in light of these results.
abstract_ja: 卵巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍と、卵黄嚢組織を成分として持つ胚細胞腫瘍の患者29例(卵黄嚢腫瘍16例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍11例、胎児性癌1例、多胚葉腫1例)を、減量手術と併用化学療法で治療した。本群における予後因子を検討した。病期I症例は、病期IIおよびIVの症例よりも予後良好であった(P<0.003)。残存腫瘍がない症例、および腹水が無いか100ml未満の症例では、予後の差は有意であった。腸型または微小嚢胞型パターンを示す卵黄嚢腫瘍は、死亡例より生存者に多くみられた。年齢、術前の血清αフェトプロテイン値、最大腫瘍径、腫瘍重量は予後と有意な相関を示さなかった。進行例では、シスプラチンを含む化学療法レジメンが、ビンクリスチン、ダクチノマイシン、シクロホスファミドを含むものより良好な成績であった(P<0.05)。卵巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍または卵黄嚢成分を有する腫瘍の最適な治療について、これらの結果に基づいて考察する。
